title: M15 up against M5 down: an unresolved conflict
why: Rule 5 for the Day Trader: M15 is an uptrend and M5 a downtrend, no earlier row matches, and MCD3 reports no consolidated trend, so the Day Trader stands aside (no archetype, no zones). The Scalper does not look at M15: its rule 3s gives a SHORT with the M5 trend, and the same trend conflict at MCD3 makes that reading CAUTIONARY (MODIFIER_CAUTION). The two trader types disagree in direction, which is the point of two readings per cycle (ADR-028).
